servinfosub.title: DTC Detecting Condition and Trouble Area

entry.ptxt: Verification error between combination meter and dual sensor brake support control module.

item.ptxt: Dual sensor brake support control module

servinfosub.title: System Description
servinfosub.ptxt: If there is a verification error between vehicle specification information registered in dual sensor brake support control module and combination meter, dual sensor brake support control module recognizes it as a fault. This DTC is detected only when dual sensor brake support control module or combination meter is replaced with another one that has different vehicle specification information.

servinfosub.title: DTC Troubleshooting

attention3.ptxt: DTC C1681 can be detected as a current DTC but it is not stored as a history DTC.

servinfosub.ptxt: Check that vehicle specification information registered in combination meter matches the actual vehicle specification.
If the correct combination meter is installed, different vehicle specification information may be registered in dual sensor brake support control module.
